caption:
Figure 2: GaugeRoPE overview. GaugeRoPE represents each historical token with two latent
components: a RoPE-compatible carrier 𝐳 s \mathbf{z}_{s} for the rotary key path
and a position-independent RKV code 𝐛 s \mathbf{b}_{s} for complementary residual-key
and value information. The two paths produce complementary
attention scores that are combined before softmax, while values are
aggregated in latent space and decoded once, avoiding per-token historical
native-K/V reconstruction.
